proposed_flow.title: Connect Puppet Master to an AI provider
proposed_flow.purpose: Explain the one thing the app needs before it can help: at least one provider account.
proposed_flow.body_copy: Puppet Master needs an AI provider account before it can plan or code with you. Start with a paid provider for the most reliable setup. You can skip this and come back later.
proposed_flow.notes: No Settings tour, no model jargon, no provider internals, and no Doctor drill-down on the first screen.

proposed_flow.title: Set up a paid provider
proposed_flow.purpose: Let the user connect one paid provider with one obvious primary action.
proposed_flow.body_copy: Pick the provider account you want Puppet Master to use first. We will open the provider setup flow and bring you back here when it is done.
proposed_flow.notes: Rows stay friendly and compact; expanded details may exist later, but not as the default path.

proposed_flow.title: Optional: Free Models
proposed_flow.purpose: Expose Fee/Free Models only after the paid-provider prompt has happened.
proposed_flow.body_copy: Free Models can help stretch your budget. They may need their own sign-in, quota, or provider setup. You can review them now or continue to Planning Wizard.
proposed_flow.notes: If opened, the Free Models top 10 remains global across all providers/models and does not use recommendation or coding-strength language.

proposed_flow.title: You are ready to plan
proposed_flow.purpose: Close setup, point to Assistant Chat/Teacher, and route into Planning Wizard.
proposed_flow.body_copy: Need help later? Ask Assistant Chat for Teacher. Try: 'What does this mean?' or 'Show me how to use this page.' Teacher explains the current screen from chat.
proposed_flow.notes: Completed setup routes to Planning Wizard with provider setup state carried forward.

skip_behavior.candidate_rule: Skip for now routes directly to Planning Wizard in a limited setup state rather than to the dense shell.
skip_behavior.visible_copy: Provider setup is not finished. You can still open Planning Wizard, but assistant features may need a provider before they can run.
skip_behavior.health_state: Doctor/Health shows provider setup as Needs setup, not Ready.

doctor_health_summary.candidate_role: Doctor remains a compact Health summary after onboarding, not a setup wizard clone and not a generic result registry.
doctor_health_summary.normal_visibility: Show the simplest next action first, with advanced diagnostics behind details/support.

handoff_to_planning_wizard.candidate_rule: The wizard should pass a structured onboarding_setup_state into the Planning Wizard route/seed, not a raw onboarding transcript.
handoff_to_planning_wizard.visible_outcome: Planning Wizard opens as the first full app page after setup or skip.

open_review_points: Confirm whether Skip for now should always route to Planning Wizard in limited state.
Confirm whether the Free Models screen should appear automatically after a paid provider connects or only as an optional next step.
Confirm the exact provider rows once the supported provider set is selected for first-run.
non_actions: No Plans/.plan_index, WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, Spec_Lock, shards, evidence, plan_graph, or auto_decisions were created or updated.
acceptance_notes: Jared accepted the candidate proposal with exact reply: `That all looks good.`
